section_1.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Estia Payments S.A. (“we”, “us”, “our”) is committed to protecting the privacy and personal data of our users. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information in connection with our payment services gateway.

This policy is designed to comply with the <bold>General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR),</bold> the <bold>Greek Data Protection Law,</bold> and all other applicable EU data protection and financial regulatory requirements.

section_2.title: Data Controller and Contact Information
paragraphs: Estia Payments S.A. is the <bold>data controller</bold> responsible for your personal data.
If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, you may contact our <bold>Data Protection Officer (DPO):</bold>
📧 Email: dpo@estiapayments.io
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (HDPA) or your local supervisory authority in the EU.

section_3.title: Scope of Services
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy applies to all our services, including but not limited to:
list: Our website
Our applications (desktop and mobile)
Our mobile applications
Our APIs
Other digital platforms provided by us

section_4.title: Data We Collect
paragraphs: In order to provide regulated payment and crypto services, and to comply with <bold>anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorism financing (CTF),</bold> and <bold>MiCA</bold> obligations, we may collect the following categories of personal data:
list: Identification data: Full name, date of birth, nationality, gender
Contact details: Residential address, professional address, telephone number, email address
Professional and financial information: Profession, bank details, source of wealth/funds
Transactional data: Payment instructions, transaction history, crypto wallet addresses
Verification data: ID documents, proof of address, biometric verification (if applicable)
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device information, cookies and tracking data
footer: We will not collect more data than necessary for the purposes described below.

section_5.title: Purposes of Data Processing
paragraphs: We process your personal data for the following purposes:
list: <bold>Contractual necessity:</bold> To provide and manage our payment services gateway.
<bold>Legal and regulatory compliance:</bold> To meet AML, CTF, MiCA, and other financial regulatory obligations.
<bold>Fraud prevention and monitoring:</bold> To protect our systems and prevent abuse.
<bold>Customer support:</bold> To respond to your requests and resolve issues.
<bold>Marketing:</bold> To send you information about our services (only with your consent).
<bold>Service improvement:</bold> To improve performance and develop new features.

section_6.title: Legal Bases for Processing
paragraphs: We rely on the following legal grounds for processing your personal data:
list: <bold>Performance of a contract</bold> (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR)
<bold>Legal obligation</bold> (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR), e.g., AML and tax regulations
<bold>Legitimate interests</bold> (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR), e.g., fraud prevention, IT security
<bold>Consent</bold> (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), where explicitly required (e.g., marketing, cookies)

section_7.title: Automated Decision-Making and Profiling
paragraphs: Certain activities, such as <bold>AML checks, fraud detection, and risk scoring,</bold> may involve automated decision-making. These processes are necessary to comply with regulatory obligations and to ensure secure transactions.
You have the right to request human intervention, to express your point of view, and to contest automated decisions.

section_8.title: Data Sharing and Third Parties
paragraphs: We may share your personal data with:
list: <bold>Identity verification providers</bold> (for AML/KYC checks)
<bold>Payment processors and banking partners</bold>
<bold>Cloud hosting and IT service providers</bold> (within the EU/EEA)
<bold>Regulatory and supervisory authorities</bold> (when legally required)
<bold>Professional advisors</bold> (e.g., auditors, legal counsel)
footer: We ensure that all third parties comply with GDPR and apply appropriate safeguards.
section_8.info_desc: At present, we do not transfer personal data outside the EU/EEA. If such transfers become necessary, we will ensure adequate safeguards, such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or adequacy decisions, and update this Policy accordingly.

section_9.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal data only as long as necessary for legal and operational purposes:
list: <bold>Customer records (KYC/AML):</bold> 5–10 years from the end of the business relationship, as required by AML law.
<bold>Financial records:</bold> 10 years (tax compliance).</bold>
<bold><bold>Customer support data:</bold> 6 years.
<bold>Cookies and analytics data:</bold> As per your consent, usually no longer than 2 years.
footer: After expiry, data is securely deleted or anonymized.

section_10.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
paragraphs: We use cookies and similar technologies to:
list: Provide website functionality
Collect analytics and performance data
Support service improvements
Deliver personalized marketing (only with your consent)
footer: Upon first visit, you will see a <bold>cookie consent banner</bold> where you can accept, reject, or customize cookie preferences. You can also change your preferences anytime via browser settings or our consent tool.

section_11.title: Data Security
paragraphs: We implement strict technical and organizational measures, including:
list: <bold>Encryption</bold> of data at rest and in transit
<bold>Access controls</bold> with role-based restrictions
<bold>Regular penetration testing and security audits</bold>
<bold>Employee training</bold> on data protection and confidentiality

section_12.title: Your Rights Under GDPR
paragraphs: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
list: <bold>Access:</bold> Obtain a copy of your personal data.
<bold>Rectification:</bold> Correct inaccuracies.
<bold>Erasure:</bold> Request deletion (subject to regulatory retention).
<bold>Restriction</bold> Limit processing under certain conditions.
<bold>Data portability:</bold> Receive data in a structured, machine-readable format.
<bold>Objection:</bold> Object to processing, including direct marketing.
<bold>Withdraw consent:</bold> Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it anytime.
footer: We will respond to all valid requests within <bold>one month</bold> (extendable by two months in complex cases).

section_13.title: Children’s Data
paragraphs: Our services are not intended for children under the age of <bold>16</bold>. We do not knowingly collect or process their data. If you believe we have collected such data, please contact us to have it deleted.

section_14.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any material changes will be communicated through our website, applications, or by email. We encourage you to review this Policy regularly.

section_15.title: Governing Law and Jurisdiction
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy is governed by the laws of <bold>Greece</bold> and the <bold>European Union.</bold> Any disputes will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of <bold>Athens, Greece</bold>.
